fixture.target_source: shared bank v2e_display_luma_u8; same endpoint target used for both event-generator arms
fixture.target_endpoint_set: the physical artifact contains all 201 shared endpoints t_0..t_200; t_0 is the recurrent boundary only, while the 200 inferable targets are t_1..t_200
fixture.event_window: reset recurrent state at t_0 without a model call; each target t_i, i=1..200, receives events in (t_i-1,t_i] with EventGenesis timestamps in seconds and V2E timestamps converted from microseconds

inference.input: event only, EVREAL MemMapDataset between_frames five signed temporal bins; reference pixels are deleted before model call
inference.hidden_state: one reset at t_0; recurrent state continues through all 200 windows
inference.resolution: pad native 260x346 with pinned CropParameters then crop to exact 260x346
inference.output_mapping: record finite raw range; clip once to [0,1]; save float32 and uint8 without per-frame normalization
inference.device: CPU for isolation from other users' GPU allocations
inference.saved_endpoints: all 200 inferable outputs t_1..t_200 in chronological order; no zero-event pseudo-window is passed to the model

metrics.LPIPS_AlexNet: grayscale repeated to RGB; fixed linear map from [0,1] to [-1,1]; pinned PerceptualSimilarity v0.1 weights
metrics.PSNR: data_range=1; exact match represented as +infinity plus an exact-match flag
metrics.aggregation: arithmetic mean across all 200 registered inferable endpoints
